initialCommit.subject: fix(stage12): share precompute matrix read cache

notExecuted: A local direct runtime profiler was not completed because the worktree shell lacked SG_RUNTIME_INTERNAL_FORECAST_SERVICE_TOKEN.

findings: The first implementation on commit 4b3a5442fb5fc24f44676a9d8062f2f62fe8eed9 fixed shared cache identity but still failed live before MATRIX because PRECOMPUTE warm-up fan-out was too high.
The final implementation on commit db177e4931b9ce7247393b40448c11811bdc51cc preserved the shared-cache design and resolved the live fan-out issue by sequencing warm-up per variant.
Brent final live REVALIDATE showed PRECOMPUTE PASS, point-in-time evaluation began, all 12 variants completed, and MATRIX non-point-in-time current and verification misses both dropped to zero.
Aluminium final live REVALIDATE matched Brent on the targeted cache-reuse proof surface.
The targeted pre-MATRIX environment timeout regression is resolved on both validated series.
The remaining live failure class is REREAD_FAIL rather than ENVIRONMENT_NOT_READY.
No SG Runtime source change, timeout increase, MATRIX semantic change, or point-in-time PRECOMPUTE warm-up was introduced.
residualRisks: Full benchmark acceptance remains partial because both validated series still fail closed with REREAD_FAIL.
This task does not repair runtime reread readiness or any separate freshness issue.
Legacy deprecation must remain blocked until the remaining benchmark-level fail-closed outcome is addressed by a separate task.

decisions: Keep the corrective inside apps/dashboard-preview and leave acceptance-matrix semantics unchanged.
Preserve exact cadence-derived cache identity between PRECOMPUTE and MATRIX.
Reduce live PRECOMPUTE pressure by sequencing non-point-in-time warm-up per variant instead of dispatching all variants at once.
Classify the task as PARTIAL_SUCCESS because the target cache-reuse regression is fixed and proven live, while full benchmark certification still fails closed for a different reason.

recommendations: Treat the precompute-to-matrix shared read cache corrective as complete for the targeted regression.
Open a follow-up only for the remaining REREAD_FAIL benchmark outcome if full benchmark acceptance is required.
Keep any next task scoped away from SG Runtime mutation unless new evidence forces that boundary to move.
